reviews.text:
We used your hotel services.

We were a little worried at first about leaving our beloved cat for an extended period while we traveled abroad, but the staff took such wonderful care of her that we were able to enjoy our trip with peace of mind.

During her stay, they sent us frequent updates on her meals and bathroom routines, as well as photos and videos. We were so happy to see her gradually getting used to the staff and eventually cuddling and playing happily.

We are truly grateful for their willingness to accommodate our detailed requests.

We believe this is a very trustworthy pet hotel where you can confidently leave your precious cat.

Thank you so much to all the staff.

We would definitely like to use your services again if the opportunity arises.

I chose this salon because it was close to me in Akasaka!

The interior was stylish, and I could see the treatment process through the glass!

The finished result was beautiful and my hair was so fluffy! I'm very satisfied♪

The skills and service were top-notch! My usually wary cat was relaxed and playing when I picked him up.
This was my first time using this salon. My cat is a 2-year-old long-haired male, and I was worried because he was very nervous and withdrawn at first, but I was surprised when I went to pick him up!
He seemed to have completely opened up to the staff and was happily running around and playing in the shop. Because animals can't speak, I was truly moved by how gently and lovingly they treated him, which was evident at a glance.
The shampoo and cut were also perfect, highlighting the beauty of his long hair, making him fluffy and perfect. I've found the best salon I can trust completely. I'll definitely be back next time!
The staff were very kind, and the results were beautiful. I'm extremely satisfied. I'll definitely come again!

It was a very beautiful salon.

They worked efficiently and carefully, and my dog's coat is the most beautiful it's ever been.

I've decided to bring my dog ​​there regularly for grooming.

I'll definitely be back.

We used the hotel.

The room was spacious, and our child was able to relax comfortably.

We were able to check in with a camera, and they also sent us photos and videos, so we felt at ease leaving our child in their care.

They also gave our child a shampoo, and we were very happy with how fluffy their fur was!

We will definitely use your services again!

I used their pet hotel and shampoo/cut service for the first time, and on my second visit, I requested only a shampoo/cut.

For the pet hotel, they sent frequent LINE messages with photos, which gave me peace of mind knowing how my pet was doing while they were there. I was also happy that they carefully monitored any changes in my pet's health and explained everything in detail.

The staff were very kind and attentive, paying attention to even the smallest details, so I felt completely at ease leaving my pet in their care. As a first-time cat owner, they were very helpful and gave me lots of advice on things like food, which was very reassuring.

For the shampoo/cut, I asked for "just a round shape," and I was very happy with the fluffy, perfectly round, and adorable result! Their skills were excellent, and I was delighted that they achieved exactly what I wanted. My pet smelled wonderful when I returned home.

The shop itself was very clean, beautiful, and a comfortable space. I would definitely like to use their services again for future long trips.

This was the first time I took my cat to the salon.

The staff were all very kind and helpful, which made me feel really at ease.

After the shampoo, my cat was so energetic, fluffy, and adorable! 💛✨

I also used the cat hotel on the upper floor.

The rooms were very clean and well-partitioned, and there were security cameras in every room, so I felt safe being able to keep an eye on my cat at all times. I will definitely leave my cat there again.
My beloved Minuet cat was given a very cute teddy bear makeover. The shop is clean and has adorable cats.

I had him trimmed and shampooed.
He usually gets fussy when his nails are clipped, but he was very calm throughout.
His fur was fluffy afterwards, so I'm glad I had him trimmed.

It was our first visit! ✨️
I had seen the cute interior on social media and was intrigued even before it opened.

My two dogs hate shampooing, but the groomer's attentive service and friendly personality made them very well-behaved. 🐈
It's close to Akasaka Station and within walking distance of Roppongi and Nogizaka, so we were able to do some cafe hopping while we waited.

I'm amazed that even now, a week later, they're still soft, fluffy, and odor-free!

I'll definitely be back with my two dogs! 🐈🐈‍⬛

They provided very thorough and attentive service, which gave me peace of mind during my trip. 🥺
I would definitely like to use their services again for future long trips. 🥺✨ …

Thank you for taking such good care of my pet at the hotel for two weeks!

It's a safe and reliable environment.

Thank you for the shampoo as well!

I was very satisfied.
I didn't like leaving my cat in a cage, so I found this place and used it.
The stylish and comfortable environment made it easy to leave my cat there. The staff were very polite and updated me once a day with photos.
I also really appreciated being able to monitor the cat's condition 24 hours a day via camera.

I was nervous on the first day, but they didn't bother me more than necessary and respected the cat's pace. I really felt they were thinking about my cat.

They even gave him a shampoo, and he's now so fluffy.

I look forward to seeing you again.

The staff were very kind.

It's a place you can trust. 👍 …

I used this service for my cat's first shampoo! He hates grooming and would run away from the staff and hiss at them, but they were able to groom him efficiently! After we got home, his fur was fluffy and the smell around his bottom was gone. Thank you very much!

I visited once for a tour, and the store was very clean, and the staff made a great impression. Even the smallest room in the hotel was spacious enough for one adult to relax comfortably, and I felt confident leaving my pet there. I would definitely like to use their services again if I have the opportunity.

Incidentally, I heard that the staff also have experience working at an animal hospital, which is another reason to feel at ease.

This was my first time using their service, and I'm absolutely thrilled!
My dog ​​is a little timid, but the staff took their time to help him get used to them, and he was very calm during the grooming.
The finished result is fluffy and smells wonderful! His fur looks incredibly beautiful.
It's reassuring to know that he's being groomed by professionals. I would definitely like to use their services again.

This was my first time using your services.

The space was stylish and clean, which made me feel at ease.

All the staff were beautiful, which was a treat for the eyes.

My cat, the most important thing, seemed relaxed and comfortable in the bath.

My cat is usually shy around strangers, but she seemed fine here, and I'd love to give her another bath.

When I wash her, there are always parts I can't get clean, and the hairdryer gets tired halfway through, but

Professionals really are different.

She's fluffy and smells wonderful; I'm very satisfied.

Thank you.

This was my first time leaving my cat at SHIPPONA.

The staff were truly passionate about cats, and my cat seemed to relax right away.

The private rooms were very clean, and they provided detailed reports with photos of my cat's stay, which gave me peace of mind. My cat had lots of fun playing, so I was able to travel without her feeling lonely. Thank you very much.

This was also my first time using their grooming service, and the result was wonderful – so fluffy and cute! It's a huge difference from when I wash her at home...

As a cat specialist, I felt they were very knowledgeable and attentive to every detail.

I look forward to using their services again next time.
